content: Designed and developed a habit-tracking application featuring mandala-inspired visualizations that grow with user progress, transforming routine data into meaningful visual patterns
Envision this design integrated into existing systems like gym or yoga studio apps where user data is already collected, reducing onboarding friction, keeping user engagement challenges in mind
Without an institutional buyer, would enhance standalone version with features to improve user buy-in

Created full technical implementation from initial mandala design to data architecture to interactive frontend, leveraging AWS Lambda for backend processing and custom javascript for dynamic, SVG-based visualizations
Creates a visual growth metaphor—each completed habit adds a "petal" to the mandala, that reflect consistency over time
Draws on the meditative quality of mandalas to connect to mindful reflection on progress
Supports many options for personalization, including color schemes, and visualization shapes
